zh: 我行咗成日都冇位坐，好攰。

target: I'll join you on the fishing trip.

target: The bowl of rice was finished immediately.

zh: 咋咋聲食晒碗飯。
target: The bowl of rice was quickly devoured.

en: He's crazy, of course. Why bother with him?
zh: 佢傻𠺢嘛，使乜理佢唧？
target: He's crazy, who cares about him?

zh: 佢個樣#三尖八角 奇形怪狀咁，點見得人呀？
target: He has a rather angular and unattractive face.

en: Why that person can be re-employed after retirement?
zh: 嗰個人明明退咗休𠺝，點解可以翻閹？
target: Why can that person be re-employed after retirement?

en: It will be over once you wake up after sleep.
zh: 瞓醒就冇事嚕。
target: You'll be fine once you wake up.

en: It will be over once you wake up after sleep.
zh: 瞓醒就冇事嚕。
target: Everything will be fine once you wake up.

en: Inn in ancient times is equivalent to hotel room nowadays.
zh: 古時候嘅客棧廂房即係而家嘅酒店房。
target: Ancient inns are equivalent to hotel rooms nowadays.

zh: 用起重機搬開啲石開路。
target: Use the crane to move those rocks away and clear a path.

en: Use the derrick to move those rocks away and to open the way.
zh: 用起重機搬開啲石開路。

zh: 用起重機搬開啲石開路。
target: Use the crane to remove these stones and make way.

zh: 「幾時食飯啊？」「未有耐啦。」
target: "When are we eating?" "It's too soon to say."

en: Where are your principles! You said you were to boycott the shop. Let's not (give in and) buy from them when there's a discount.
zh: 俾啲骨氣吖！又話杯葛呢間舖，唔好特價就衝去買啦。
target: Show some backbone! You said you were going to boycott the shop. Let's not buy from them just because there's a discount.

en: Where are your principles! You said you were to boycott the shop. Let's not (give in and) buy from them when there's a discount.

en: If you had studied hard, you would not have failed the test.
zh: 若果你努力啲温書，測驗就唔會唔合格。
target: If you had studied harder, you wouldn't have failed the test.

en: If you had studied hard, you would not have failed the test.
zh: 若果你努力啲温書，測驗就唔會唔合格。
target: Had you studied harder, you wouldn't have failed the test.

zh: 做事懶散，只會事倍功半。
target: Laziness results in twice the effort for half the results.

en: Working sluggishly will only twice the effort required with half the results.

target: Working sluggishly means you'll put in twice the effort for half the result.

zh: 做事懶散，只會事倍功半。
target: Working sluggishly means putting in twice the effort for half the result.

en: There's a bleeding blood vessel on your eye.
zh: 你隻眼爆咗條微絲血管喎。
target: You have a burst blood vessel in your eye.

en: I drink sometimes.
zh: 我耐唔中都會飲吓酒㗎。
target: I occasionally drink.

en: I drink sometimes.
zh: 我耐唔中都會飲吓酒㗎。
target: I drink occasionally.

en: If you work too hard and compromise your health when you are young, you will not have to enjoy your wealth no matter how much you earned.
zh: 後生嗰時捱壞咗副偈，賺幾多都冇命享啦！
target: If you compromise your health by working too hard when you are young, you won't get to enjoy the wealth you earn.

en: If you work too hard and compromise your health when you are young, you will not have to enjoy your wealth no matter how much you earned.

en: If you work too hard and compromise your health when you are young, you will not have to enjoy your wealth no matter how much you earned.

target: If you work too hard and compromise your health when you are young, no matter how much wealth you've earned, you won't be able to enjoy it.

en: Don't be mad! You two are fine.
zh: 你唔好又喺度叫春啦，明明你哋就冇嘢。
target: Don't get angry, you two are fine.

en: Don't be mad! You two are fine.
zh: 你唔好又喺度叫春啦，明明你哋就冇嘢。

zh: 佢去咗外國咁多年，整整下連中文都唔識講。
target: He has been abroad for so long that he barely speaks Chinese now.

en: He has been to foreign country for many years, after the long period of time he can hardly speak Chinese now.
zh: 佢去咗外國咁多年，整整下連中文都唔識講。
target: He has lived abroad for so long that he's forgotten how to speak Chinese.

en: You have to rewind the tape to the beginning.
zh: 你要將餅帶倒返去最前嗰度。
target: You need to rewind the tape back to the beginning.

en: You have to rewind the tape to the beginning.
zh: 你要將餅帶倒返去最前嗰度。
target: You need to rewind the tape back to the start.

zh: 佢直至到十八歲都俾人收埋響閨房深處，所以未見過出面嘅世界。
target: She was confined to her bedroom until she turned eighteen and has never seen the world outside.

zh: 條友同我sell保險，我都費事睬佢。

zh: 出去呀！我唔想見到你呀！
target: Get out of here! I don't want to see you!

zh: 佢成日返返下工就會鼠咗入士多房蛇王。

zh: 點解你幾時都on住line，好似唔使瞓噉嘅？

zh: 你今鋪真係害死我喇！
target: You've really gotten me into a lot of trouble this time!

en: Your record is very poor!
zh: 你個底好花喎！
target: Your track record is terrible!

en: I didn't expect you will be dragged into this mess.
zh: 估唔到連你都要落水搞呢單嘢。
target: I didn't expect you to get involved in this mess too.

zh: 劇情峰迴路轉，令觀眾喜出望外。
target: The drama's plot is full of twists and turns that delighted the audience.

en: Go eating as soon as you are done playing!
zh: 玩完好食飯喇！
target: Let's go eat once you're done playing!

en: These two handbags seem to have little difference, I don't know which is better.
zh: 呢兩個手袋睇落差唔多，我都唔知有咩分別。
target: These two handbags seem very similar; I can't tell the difference.

en: The staff were not very nice.
zh: 啲職員態度麻麻囉。
target: The staff were rather unfriendly.

en: The staff were not very nice.
zh: 啲職員態度麻麻囉。
target: The staff members were rather unfriendly.

zh: 嗰位朋友喇喎，就冇乜風度喇。
target: That friend, on the other hand, lacks grace.

en: Now that mate—in contrast—is lacking in chivalry and gracious manners.
zh: 嗰位朋友喇喎，就冇乜風度喇。
target: That friend, on the other hand, lacks gentlemanly behavior.

en: Everyone got a bit tipsy after drinking.
zh: 摸完酒杯底，大家都貓貓哋。
target: Everyone became slightly inebriated from drinking.

en: Everyone got a bit tipsy after drinking.
zh: 摸完酒杯底，大家都貓貓哋。
target: After drinking, everyone became slightly inebriated.

zh: 阿怡兼職返緊西餐廳侍應，啲貼士都係歸佢嘅。
target: Ah Yi works part-time as a waitress at a Western restaurant, and she keeps all her tips.

zh: 個雞棚就冧，走得好走。
target: The scheme is about to collapse, quit while you can.

zh: 個雞棚就冧，走得好走。
target: The jig is up, better quit while you still can.

en: I've never tried taking the contraceptives before and I want to try, which of the brands have less side-effects?
zh: 我未食過避孕藥，想試下，有冇邊隻牌子冇咁多副作用？

zh: 揀唔落啊！餐牌上都冇樣嘢啱我口味。
target: I can't decide! There's nothing on the menu that appeals to me.

zh: 兩件事都唔𠸎耕嘅。

target: In me, the tiger hesitantly smells the rose.

zh: 紅事撞白事好唔吉利。
target: It's considered bad luck when a joyous event coincides with a sad one.

en: He has no conscience but ambition. He might be a thorn in our side if we let him stay.
zh: 呢個人視良知如無物，而且野心勃勃，留佢喺度日後必成心腹大患。
target: He lacks a conscience, but is ambitious; he might be a thorn in our side if we let him stay.

en: He has no conscience but ambition. He might be a thorn in our side if we let him stay.

zh: 我部門個阿頭霸住屎坑唔痾屎。
target: My department head is like a dog guarding an empty bone, not utilizing resources.

en: You're not a kid anymore, and I don't think I need to explain everything to you. Need I swear to get you out of here blushing?
zh: 咁大個人唔係要畫公仔畫出腸呀嘛，唔使下下粗口問候先面懵懵咁行開。
target: You're not a kid anymore, and I don't think I need to explain everything to you. Do I really have to use profanity just to make you leave with a flushed face?

zh: 香港就嚟冧喇。
target: Hong Kong is on the verge of collapse.

target: Don't worry, I'll look after him.

zh: 肚餓喇，不如食返食開嗰間茶記啦！
target: I'm hungry. Let's go to our usual cha chaan teng.

zh: I. 1962年有套西片《Lolita》香港譯做《一樹梨花壓海棠》，內容係講老少不倫戀。而Lolita呢個名因此被用嚟形容具有性魅力嘅早熟少女。

As a result, the name Lolita has since been used to describe early-maturing girls with sexual appeal.

As this process is rather slow, we can, through different methods, detect pathologies in the colon before it evolves into cancer. One of the most common methods of screening is fecal occult blood testing.

en: Early human society kept wolves as pets. People at that time selectively bred wolves that were less ferocious, and, over successive generations, caused the wolves they kept to become more and more tamed - resulting in a new animal, dogs. This is an example of biological domestication.
zh: 早期嘅人類社會有養狼。嗰陣時啲人選擇性咁淨係將啲野性冇咁犀利嘅狼攞去配種，一代一代咁令到佢哋養嗰啲狼嘅性格同特徵變得愈嚟愈温順－形成咗狗呢種新動物。呢個就係生物學上「馴養」嘅一個例子。
target: Early human society kept wolves as pets. People at that time selectively bred wolves that were less ferocious, and over successive generations, this caused the wolves they kept to become more and more tame, resulting in the new animal we know as dogs. This is an example of biological domestication.

target: That hat doesn't look as nice as the other one.

en: Your messy mop of hair makes you look lethargic and unenergetic. Do something about it!
zh: 你個頭褸褸丘丘冇嚟精神，執下佢啦。
target: Your messy hair makes you look lethargic and unenergetic. Tidy it up!

en: Our grandpa went to the park and exercised in the early morning.
zh: 阿婆大清早就落咗公園晨運。
target: Our grandma went to the park for her morning exercise very early.

en: Some colleagues said that it did not matter, for legislation would be proceeded with in two years. Phew!
zh: 有啲同事話唔緊要，兩年後做就得，哈！兩年後，我俾個官你做！
target: Some colleagues said it doesn't matter, as the law will pass in two years. Phew! In two years, I'll give you a promotion!

en: The "Buddhist" way to buy the first apartment is to be content without saving any money. When good luck comes, you will get your apartment.
zh: 佛系#上車 法就係唔#儲錢，#緣份 到喇喎，咪上到車。
target: The "Buddhist" approach to buying your first apartment is to accept not saving money. When good fortune arrives, you'll buy one.

en: Mixed beans sweet soup with taro came from Malaysia.
zh: 喳喳係馬來西亞嘅糖水。
target: Yam and mixed bean dessert soup, also known as Chow Chow, originated from Malaysia.

en: Please tell me the whole story from beginning to end in no time!
zh: 你快啲將呢件事嘅來龍去脈講俾我聽啦！
target: Quickly, tell me the whole story from beginning to end.

en: Please tell me the whole story from beginning to end in no time!
zh: 你快啲將呢件事嘅來龍去脈講俾我聽啦！
target: Please share the entire story with me as quickly as possible.

en: He can't resist the seduce of women.
zh: 佢抵擋唔住女人嘅誘惑。
target: He can't resist women's advances.

en: Is working at HR department easy and relaxing?
zh: 人力資源部係咪好好做？
target: Is the HR job stress-free?

en: Why this room is empty?
zh: 間房咁空框框嘅？
target: Why is this room so empty?

en: Are you suffering from sore throat? Ask the hawker to throw some aeroplane olives upstairs!
zh: 你喉嚨痛呀？叫樓下飛兩包飛機欖上嚟啦！
target: Are you having a sore throat? Ask the hawker downstairs to bring up two packs of aeroplane olives.

en: Hey! My character is about to get wasted. Bring some potions here to save me.
zh: 喂我隻角色就瓜老襯啦，快啲攞啲藥水嚟救我。
target: Hey! My character is about to lose. Bring some potions here to save me.

en: Why did you dye your hair so ridiculously? You're like a teddy girl!
zh: 你做乜染到個頭鬼五馬六啊？成個飛女噉！
target: What made you decide to dye your hair in such an outlandish manner? You look like a goth girl!

en: Why did you dye your hair so ridiculously? You're like a teddy girl!
zh: 你做乜染到個頭鬼五馬六啊？成個飛女噉！
target: What made you decide to dye your hair in such an outlandish manner? You look like a trendy girl!

en: Your car hit over this way, are you killing?
zh: 你架車咁樣撞埋嚟，想收買人命咩？
target: How could you drive like that? Are you trying to kill someone?

en: The briefness of the entering tones is caused by the stop codas -p, -t and -k.
zh: 入聲之所以短促急收藏，乃-p、-t、-k塞音韻尾所致。
target: The briefness of the entering tones is due to final stops -p, -t, and -k.

en: My rolling cigarette is much better than pack.
zh: 煙仔都冇我嘅針嘜好。
target: My hand-rolled cigarette is much better than a pack.

en: The dishes are left unfinished.
zh: 啲菜腳冇人幫手清。
target: No one helped clean the dishes.

en: Except folding those blanket firmly and create shape creases, they know nothing.
zh: 佢哋除咗摺被摺到起角之外，乜都唔識。
target: They know nothing except properly folding blankets to create creases.

en: I hope he can train up the skill first, instead of  just buying all the top gears, everyone will deride you pretentious
zh: 好心佢練好啲技術先啦，初學已經買晒頂級裝備，一定俾人笑屎波架撐多。
target: He should focus on developing his skills first, instead of buying the best equipment right away; otherwise, people might laugh at his pretentiousness.

en: Stop being nonsense madam.  Their store have sold out and it's unlikely they can give you anything. Stop being rude to them.
zh: 小姐唔好咁任性啦，佢地舖頭賣晒都無計，唔好再鬧佢地啦。
target: Madam, please understand that their store has sold out and they cannot help you anymore. Please do not be unreasonable or rude to them.

en: Let's order few more dishes, we prefer not to have rice.
zh: 點多兩個餸，呢抬人好大餸。
target: Let's order a couple more dishes, we'd rather skip the rice.

en: Now no one even heard of you ! You had chosen a name of no body !
zh: 依家冇人識你呀！人起朵你起朵！
target: No one recognizes you now! You've chosen a name that nobody knows.

en: to still have three month's time to revise
zh: 尚有三個月時間温習
target: There are still three months left for revision.

en: She has dated me for a boat trip.
zh: 佢約咗我去遊船河。
target: She invited me on a boat trip.

en: You have finished half of the assignment, it doesn't matter to finish the other half.
zh: 既然份功課你都做咗一半，唔掙在做埋另一半啦。
target: Since you have already completed half of the assignment, I’m sure you won’t mind finishing the other half as well.

en: You have finished half of the assignment, it doesn't matter to finish the other half.
zh: 既然份功課你都做咗一半，唔掙在做埋另一半啦。
target: Since you have already completed half of the assignment, it doesn't matter – finish the other half as well.

en: The enemies have formed a siege, it would be hard to find a safe passage to escape.
zh: 敵方已經包圍住我哋，想揾生路#著草 都唔易。
target: The enemies have surrounded us; finding a safe way out would be difficult.

en: Your behaviour simply destroys my way to make money!
zh: 你咁做即係斷我米路姐！
target: Your actions are effectively blocking my income source! You should just leave.

en: If you don't study well, you will be homeless in the future.
zh: 唔讀好啲書，你第時聽踎街都得。
target: If you don't study well, you may end up homeless in the future.

en: This bad guy doesn't deserve you to stay, you'd should leave.
zh: 呢個人唔值得你留戀，你走喇！
target: This person doesn't deserve your affection, you should leave him/her.

en: This bad guy doesn't deserve you to stay, you'd should leave.
zh: 呢個人唔值得你留戀，你走喇！
target: This person doesn't deserve your affection, you should leave.

en: This drink is called "jyun1 joeng1".
zh: 呢樣飲品叫做鴛鴦。
target: This drink is called 'Yuanyang,' a blend of coffee and tea commonly known as "Mandarin Duck Tea" in English.

en: You made my shirt so wrinkled, how can I go to work later on!
zh: 你搞到我件裇衫巢咪掹，陣間點返工呀。
target: My shirt is all wrinkled now! How am I going to go to work?

en: You are not handsome, and you can't fight, you have a complete failure in life.
zh: 睇又唔睇得，打又唔打得，你真係做鬼都唔靈。
target: You're neither good-looking nor a fighter; you've really failed in life.

en: Get lost, you are blocking the way !
zh: 死開啦，阻住條路！
target: Move aside, you're blocking the way!

en: Get lost, you are blocking the way !
zh: 死開啦，阻住條路！
target: "Move aside, you're blocking the way!"

en: May I reply to you after listening to my wife's opinion.
zh: 請容我聽聽賤內嘅意見再回覆你。
target: Let me get back to you after I consult my wife’s opinion.

en: May I reply to you after listening to my wife's opinion.
zh: 請容我聽聽賤內嘅意見再回覆你。
target: May I reply to you after listening to my wife?

en: stores on this street on average makes profit in the hundred thousands dollars
zh: 間鋪頭每年拉勻都賺到十幾萬
target: Stores on this street make an average profit of over a hundred thousand dollars per year.

en: I am such a "glass tummy", have just eaten tiny amount of frying food and get a diarrhea.
zh: 我真係玻璃肚嚟，食咗少少煎炸嘢啫，就即刻屙到 bi li bek lek。
target: I have such a sensitive stomach; even a little fried food gives me diarrhea.

en: I have just been there a moment ago.
zh: 求先我去過嗰度。
target: I was just there a moment ago.

en: You two, look, if you want to mock an argument, do it quietly.
zh: 兩位，係咁嘅，你哋耍花槍，細聲啲呀。
target: Hey, look, if you two want to argue, please keep your voices down.

en: You two, look, if you want to mock an argument, do it quietly.
zh: 兩位，係咁嘅，你哋耍花槍，細聲啲呀。
target: If you guys want to argue, please keep your voices down.

en: Someone has just shot a sniper arrow at him, all the bit and pieces about his corruption case is spreading around.
zh: 先排有人向佢放冷箭，爆晒佢貪污啲秘聞出嚟。
target: Someone started attacking him behind his back, exposing all of his corrupt scandals.

en: Someone has just shot a sniper arrow at him, all the bit and pieces about his corruption case is spreading around.
zh: 先排有人向佢放冷箭，爆晒佢貪污啲秘聞出嚟。
target: Someone has just leaked all the details about his corruption case, causing them to spread widely.

en: I bid this mobile phone on the internet.
zh: 部電話我上網 bid 返嚟嘅。
target: I won this phone in an online auction.

en: You, as a proper man, please don't always be so scared!
zh: 你男人之家就唔好成日咁蛇𠺌啦！
target: Be a real man, stop being so scared all the time!

en: You, as a proper man, please don't always be so scared!
zh: 你男人之家就唔好成日咁蛇𠺌啦！
target: "Be a real man, stop being so scared all the time!"

en: From the appearence, I cannot recognize he is an extravagant.
zh: 睇外表完全唔知佢係個架勢堂
target: I can't tell he is an extravagant person from his appearance.

en: He was pressed by a ghost last night, so he is dozy today.
zh: 佢噚晚俾鬼砸，所以今日冇乜精神。
target: He was haunted by a ghost last night, so he's very tired today.

en: As soon as he was born, he has destined to mourn his mother's death.
zh: 佢一出世就剋死咗佢阿媽。
target: As soon as he was born, his mother passed away.

en: Seeing a girl who is not very capable nor intelligent, but carrying a very expensive handbag makes me envy towards her.
zh: 呢個女仔冇咩本事但係可以用價值幾十萬一個手袋，見到真係眼赤。
target: Seeing a girl who's not particularly skilled or intelligent carrying an extremely expensive handbag truly makes me envious.

en: It's lunacy! You can't strip naked when your sister's at home!
zh: 阿妹喺屋企你都赤條條咁款，成何體統？
target: This is unacceptable! You can't go around without clothes when your sister's at home!

en: It's lunacy! You can't strip naked when your sister's at home!
zh: 阿妹喺屋企你都赤條條咁款，成何體統？
target: That's crazy! You can't go around without clothes when your sister's at home!

en: My heart is only you, but money is the only thing true to you.
zh: 我對你一片丹心，換來的只有一片苦心。
target: I am devoted to you, but all I get is heartache.

en: I am having full nights with my girlfriend every Saturday, from dusk till dawn.
zh: 我同女朋友個個星期六都行街、睇戲、食飯直落。
target: Every Saturday, my girlfriend and I go shopping, see a movie, and have dinner together.

en: Grasp the nettle for the champion.
zh: 遇到難關嗰陣都要頂硬上㗎啦。唔係點攞冠軍。
target: Face challenges bravely to become a champion.

en: Beside the pharmacy rests a jewelry shop, next to it lies another one, its neighboring one is still a jewelry shop.
zh: 藥房側跟係金舖，金舖旁邊又係金舖，金舖隔籬嗰間仍然係金舖。
target: Next to the pharmacy lies a jewelry shop, followed by another one next door, and still another adjacent to it.

en: You chat with him frequently. Are you in love with him?
zh: 你同佢密密斟，係咪#有路 唧？
target: Do you have feelings for him?

en: You are blocking the road at its center, how can others pass by?
zh: 你喺條路中心度拃著晒，其他人唔使行啦。
target: You're standing in the middle of the road, obstructing others from passing.

en: After his unsuccess vindication, he has been stagnant and no mood to do anything.
zh: 佢食咗檸檬之後，一直萎靡不振，無心機做任何嘢。
target: After he was rejected, he has been demotivated and lacks the motivation to do anything.

en: After his unsuccess vindication, he has been stagnant and no mood to do anything.
zh: 佢食咗檸檬之後，一直萎靡不振，無心機做任何嘢。
target: After his failed attempt at vindication, he has been demotivated and lacks the motivation to do anything.

en: This no.8 is a wet handkerchief, keep twisting on his own and refuse to pass.
zh: 呢個8號仔正一濕手巾，顧住自己扭波，死都唔肯交
target: Player number 8 is useless, just focusing on his own twists and refusing to pass.

en: Hurrah! Boss is great!
zh: 老闆萬歲！
target: Cheers for the boss!

en: The government of Africa is finally overpowered after the civil war.
zh: 非洲嘅政府經過內戰之後終於倒台。
target: After the civil war, the African government was overthrown.

en: The lorry behind us is sticking on our back, what's the deal with him?
zh: 後面架貨車成日響度啄尾，趕住去死咩。
target: The lorry behind us keeps tailgating, what's his hurry?

en: Her face small as a palm.
zh: 佢塊面同巴掌一樣咁細。
target: Her face is as small as the palm of my hand.

en: Her face small as a palm.
zh: 佢塊面同巴掌一樣咁細。
target: Her face is as small as a palm.

en: Cut yourself down to size!
zh: 量下自己條件先啦！
target: Be realistic about your abilities!

en: This organisation receives funds from many different people!
zh: 呢個組織有好多人#泵水 俾佢哋㗎！
target: This organization receives donations from many people.

en: This organisation receives funds from many different people!
zh: 呢個組織有好多人#泵水 俾佢哋㗎！
target: This organization receives donations from many people!

en: We can find the Polaris using Dubhe and Merak in the big dipper.
zh: 用#北斗七星 嘅天樞、天旋星可以揾到北極星㗎！
target: We can find Polaris using Dubhe and Merak in the Big Dipper.

en: I've heard that she won't wear any underwear while she is on stage. Pay attention to it.
zh: 聽講今日個歌星會真空上陣，打醒十二分精神喇。
target: I've heard that she will perform without underwear. Be prepared for an eye-catching performance.

en: I've heard that she won't wear any underwear while she is on stage. Pay attention to it.
zh: 聽講今日個歌星會真空上陣，打醒十二分精神喇。
target: I've heard that she will perform without underclothes. Be prepared for an eye-catching performance.

en: This bus didn't stop either. Screw that.
zh: 妖，呢部巴士又飛埋站。
target: The bus skipped this station again, damn it.

en: This bus didn't stop either. Screw that.
zh: 妖，呢部巴士又飛埋站。
target: This bus didn't stop at the station again, damn it.

en: Are you out of your freaking mind?
zh: 你係咪痴Q線㗎？
target: Are you out of your mind?

en: What the heck are you doing?
zh: 你做乜Q呀？
target: What are you doing?

en: Why is my food delivery still not arrive yet?
zh: 點解我個外賣咁耐都未到嘅？
target: Why hasn't my food delivery arrived yet?

en: The birthday of king was called 'manjiu', and 'chinchau' for a prince.
zh: 以前皇帝生日叫「萬壽」，王爺就叫「千秋」。
target: In the past, the emperor's birthday was called 'Man-Jiu', and a prince's was called 'Chin-Chau'.

en: This naughty girl, did not like to study all the way from child, I wonder how she can find a job with no qualification.
zh: 呢個衰女，由細到大都唔肯讀書，依家個社會無學歷點揾工？
target: This girl never liked studying since young; I wonder how she'll find a job without any qualifications now.

en: Is it easy to sneak in your hall to spend a night?
zh: 你間hall屈唔屈得蛇㗎？
target: Is it easy to sneak into your dorm for an overnight stay?

en: The lease of his shop expired and he could only dump his inventory with a clearance sale, effectively selling princesses as maids.
zh: 佢間舖租約期滿，唯有減價清倉，千金小姐當丫鬟賣。
target: The lease of his shop expired, forcing a clearance sale at discounted prices, effectively selling high-end goods like they were cheap.

en: His entire family is addicted to gambling. They even go to Macau to gamble sometimes.
zh: 佢成家人都好爛賭，間唔中仲會過吓大海噉。
target: His entire family is addicted to gambling. They often travel to Macau to indulge in this habit.

en: His entire family is addicted to gambling. They even go to Macau to gamble sometimes.
zh: 佢成家人都好爛賭，間唔中仲會過吓大海噉。
target: His entire family is addicted to gambling; they often travel to Macau to indulge in this habit.

en: You've got three "two" cards, you can hardly lose in this game.
zh: 你一個人揸住三隻Dee，今鋪想輸都難啦。
target: With three 'two' cards, it's very difficult for you to lose this game.

en: The girl you loved ignored you, I afraid you even cannot become a "gun jam bing".
zh: 女神對你不屑一顧，恐怕你連 #觀音兵 都做唔成。
target: Your crush has ghosted you so badly that I'm afraid you even cannot become a "gun jam bing".

en: The girl you loved ignored you, I afraid you even cannot become a "gun jam bing".
zh: 女神對你不屑一顧，恐怕你連 #觀音兵 都做唔成。
target: The girl you loved disregarded you; I fear even becoming a 'gun jam bing,' or her devoted follower, is beyond your reach.

en: I've just finished my PhD. Do you need an odd-job man?
zh: 我啱啱讀完博士，請唔請雜工啊？
target: Now that I've just finished my PhD, would you consider me as an assistant?

en: Pour water into the box.
zh: 將水灌注入個箱度。
target: Pour the water into the box.

en: This drama comes to me as weird at best, the only lines are screaming of the actors.
zh: 成套話劇入邊演員淨係響度大叫，真係戲劇界嘅奇葩。
target: This drama stands out for its bizarre nature, filled only with actors shouting their lines.

en: Where?
zh: G. #邊便？
target: Where exactly?

en: If you don't do your homework, I am going to punish you with the rattan stick.
zh: 你再唔做功課，信唔信我將你藤條炆豬肉吖嗱？
target: If you don't do your homework, I'll cane you.

en: The "sillier" management is brainless, aren't they?
zh: 班膠層個腦係咪坐住咗㗎？
target: Is our "mis-management" really sitting on their brains?

en: The "sillier" management is brainless, aren't they?
zh: 班膠層個腦係咪坐住咗㗎？
target: Is the sillier management truly clueless?

en: Have you ever reviewed your lesson? Why do you get full red in your school report again and again?
zh: 究竟你有冇温書架？點解次次考試都滿江紅架？
target: Did you study for the test? Why do you keep getting red marks on your report card?

en: Have you ever reviewed your lesson? Why do you get full red in your school report again and again?
zh: 究竟你有冇温書架？點解次次考試都滿江紅架？
target: Did you study for the test? Why do you keep getting full red marks on your report card?

en: I don't give a damn about her, even if she is a girl.
zh: 我理鬼得佢吖，女仔都係噉話㗎喇。
target: I don't care about her, regardless of whether she's a girl.

en: The pudding is soft like a paste even after freezing. It seems that we fail to make it.
zh: 個布甸雪咗咁耐都係腍batbat，睇嚟都係失敗咗㗎喇。
target: The pudding remained soft even after refrigeration. It seems we've failed to make it.

en: The pudding is soft like a paste even after freezing. It seems that we fail to make it.
zh: 個布甸雪咗咁耐都係腍batbat，睇嚟都係失敗咗㗎喇。
target: The pudding remained soft even after freezing; it seems we've failed to make it.

en: I won't give it to you. Bite me!
zh: 我就係唔俾你呀，吹咩？
target: "Why should I?'

en: You will die! Don't dare to do that!
zh: 會死㗎，咪制添呀你。
target: You will die! Don't consent to it!

en: You will die! Don't dare to do that!
zh: 會死㗎，咪制添呀你。
target: You will die! Don't you dare do that!

en: I failed in English. How can I do?
zh: 我英文肥咗佬。點算啊？
target: I didn't do well in English. What can I do?

en: Once again the pay has not yet been received, just like the previous some-thousand n-times.
zh: 又重複唔知第幾千個n次咁收唔到人工。
target: The pay has been delayed again, just like countless previous times.

en: He couldn't make it to the toilet, and wet himself in the subway.
zh: 佢忍唔到去廁所，喺地鐵度瀨到成條褲濕晒。
target: He couldn't hold it in and ended up wetting himself in the subway.

en: Why does the government nowadays often hire scumbags as high rank officials? They all look crafty and unreliable, even worse than thieves.
zh: 做乜依家政府揾埋啲咁嘅人做高官？個個都蛇頭鼠眼，仲衰過做賊。
target: Why does the government nowadays often appoint individuals of questionable integrity to high-ranking positions? They all seem untrustworthy, more detrimental than thieves.

en: Security guard is the king now! So fierce like thugs!
zh: 實Q大晒呀！咁鬼惡！
target: Security guards are now behaving like they're in charge! So intimidating!

en: You said 4-what-8-2?
zh: 你話四咩八二話？
target: Could you repeat? Was it 4-what-8-2?

en: You said 4-what-8-2?
zh: 你話四咩八二話？
target: Did you say "4 what 82"?

en: A-chung got all dispirited after being rejected by a girl? He's so weak-willed!
zh: 阿松佢俾#女仔 拒絕咗一次就喺度頹喪？心靈咁鬼#脆弱 嘅？
target: A-chung is disheartened after being rejected by a girl. Is his emotional resilience that weak?

en: Why take that long for just changing clothes? What fashion are you making?

zh: 同佢結婚嘅話我就要同阿爸阿媽斷絕關係，呢層我諗咗好耐。
target: To marry him, I would have to disown my parents; this is something that I have given much thought.

en: My dream girl rejected my advances again, and refused to go on a date with me.
zh: I. #女神 又請我食檸檬，唔同我出街。
target: My dream girl rejected me again and wouldn't go out with me.

en: In order to have a luxurious life, he prefers making up to rich one.
zh: 為咗過到奢侈嘅生活，佢寧願黐金糠。
target: In order to live a luxurious life, he prefers associating with wealthy people.

en: She does something illicit secretly to earn money.
zh: 佢做咗啲手腳令自己賺咗一大筆錢。
target: She secretly manipulated things to make a large profit.

en: Why would you say that you're dying soon? Take it back and say something else!
zh: 做咩話自己就嚟死？𦧲口水講過！
target: Why would you say that you're about to die? Take it back and say something else!

en: These two articles are completely the same. Which one is copying from the other?
zh: 呢兩篇文章如出一轍，究竟係邊個抄邊個啊？
target: These two articles are identical. Who copied from whom?

en: Bring the bad guy to the police and undergo prosecution.
zh: 將壞人交俾警方繩之於法。
target: Hand the bad guy over to the police for prosecution.

en: How can I get rid of the blackheads on my nose?
zh: 點先可以同士多啤梨鼻講拜拜？
target: How do I get rid of blackheads on my nose?

en: What are you listening that makes you so enthralled?
zh: 聽咩聽到咁入神啊？
target: What has you so engrossed in listening?

en: Hey lazybones, why are you still sleeping? Don't you need to work today?
zh: 喂你條懶蟲仲唔起身？唔使返工呀？
target: Hey, sleepyhead, why aren't you up yet? Don't you have work today?

en: No one will bother playing E to C with real film nowadays; everyone just takes photos with digital camera and opens them in photoshop on home computers — just one click will give what you want.
zh: 依家仲邊有人用菲林玩E沖C咁煩㗎？個個影完數碼相返去開個photoshop，撳個掣咪搞掂囉。
target: Nobody bothers with E to C film processing nowadays; everyone takes digital photos and edits them on home computers with Photoshop — one click does it all.

en: Teenagers are easily corrupted by these violent comics books.
zh: 呢啲暴力漫畫好容易毒害青少年㗎。
target: These violent comic books easily corrupt teenagers.

en: You kicked my scrotum.
zh: 你踢親我個袋。
target: You kicked me in the groin.

en: live (hoi1 laaif1) to go live
zh: 開
target: Going live

en: Help your mum to scoop soup into her bowl.
zh: 去幫阿媽潷湯啦。
target: Help your mom scoop some soup into her bowl.

en: You criticised  him without knowing what is going on, and he feels so discontented now.
zh: 你咩都唔知就批評佢，佢宜家好唔gur。
target: You criticized him without understanding the situation, and now he feels very unhappy.

en: That's why people are so easily be self-satisfied like Mr Q, having HK$300 rise in salary (per month) is better than nothing.
zh: 所以話，人就係咁阿Q，有300蚊，好過無得加。
target: That's why people settle for small victories like a HK$300 raise in salary, rather than nothing at all.

en: As you claimed they are not your fellow travelers, then why are you planning to hold a primary?
zh: 既然你哋唔係同路人，仲搞咩初選？
target: Since you say they're not on the same side, why are you organizing an election?

en: That kid shat on the floor!
zh: 個細路喺地下痾茄呀！
target: The child defecated on the floor!

en: After chain playing of mahjong, a male mahjong player was believed to be too tired and faded away.
zh: 竹戰連場，男雀友疑不支暈倒。
target: After multiple games of mahjong, a male player was believed to have fainted due to exhaustion.

en: The motto of the City University of Hong Kong is "Officium et Civitas".
zh: 城市大學嘅校訓係「敬業樂群」。
target: The motto of the City University of Hong Kong is "Learn with commitment, serve with dedication."

en: Many people praise me for my excellent photography skills, which gives me a stronger sense of satisfaction.
zh: 好多人都讚我攝影技巧好。佢哋嘅讚賞真係畀到好大滿足感我。
target: Many people commend my excellent photography skills, giving me great satisfaction.

en: Are you that naive to think that the teacher will give you some points back if you keep on your campaign of pestering?
zh: 你哋唔係咁天真諗住𦧲下地，老師就會加返分畀你呀嘛？
target: Are you really so naive to think the teacher will give you extra marks if you keep bothering her?

en: Are you that naive to think that the teacher will give you some points back if you keep on your campaign of pestering?
zh: 你哋唔係咁天真諗住𦧲下地，老師就會加返分畀你呀嘛？
target: Are you really that naive to think the teacher will give you points back if you keep bothering her?

en: The pencil lead inside the eversharp pencil breaks into two parts.
zh: 我支鉛芯筆嘅鉛芯斷咗。
target: The lead in my eversharp pencil broke.

en: The pencil lead inside the eversharp pencil breaks into two parts.
zh: 我支鉛芯筆嘅鉛芯斷咗。
target: The lead in my pencil broke.

en: My order has not been delivered for long time. Is it missed?
zh: 落咗單咁耐都未出貨嘅？係咪漏單呀？
target: My order hasn't been delivered for a long time. Perhaps they missed it?

en: My order has not been delivered for long time. Is it missed?
zh: 落咗單咁耐都未出貨嘅？係咪漏單呀？
target: My order hasn't been delivered for a long time; could it have been missed?

en: This discussion about the reform is like cooking rice-less congee, as it will amount to nothing even if we discuss it for another ten years.
zh: 今次傾改革根本係煲冇米粥，傾多十年都冇用。
target: Discussing this reform is like boiling congee without rice, as it won't lead to anything meaningful no matter how long we talk about it.

en: This discussion about the reform is like cooking rice-less congee, as it will amount to nothing even if we discuss it for another ten years.
zh: 今次傾改革根本係煲冇米粥，傾多十年都冇用。
target: Discussing this reform is pointless, as it won't lead to anything meaningful no matter how long we talk about it.

en: I've worked in this company for many years. Asking myself, I was a faithful and responsible employer. Why did the boss fire me?
zh: 喺呢間公司做咗咁多年，自問盡忠職守，點解老闆要炒我呢？
target: Having worked at this company for many years, I believed myself to be a loyal and responsible employee. Why did the boss fire me?

en: When I woke up, (I found) my underpants got wet.
zh: 一瞓醒條under濕晒。
target: I woke up to find my underpants wet.

en: Please be more careful when you write. If this reaches the public we are gonna be in deep shit.
zh: 你寫嘢小心啲啦，出咗街嘅話食屎㗎。
target: Be more careful with what you write; if this gets out to the public, we'll be in deep trouble.

en: Please be more careful when you write. If this reaches the public we are gonna be in deep shit.
zh: 你寫嘢小心啲啦，出咗街嘅話食屎㗎。
target: Be more careful with your writing; if this gets out to the public, we'll be in deep trouble.

en: These matters are coming continuously.
zh: 呢啲事凜抌嚟。
target: These issues keep arising.

en: In this hall there are two bunk beds each room, which can accommodate four people.
zh: 呢間宿舍一間房放兩張碌架牀，可以住四個人。
target: This dormitory has two bunk beds per room, accommodating four people in total.

en: No one in the class can pass the last exam, so the teacher give the students hints in order to guide them for revision.
zh: 上次考試全班冇人合到格，所以今次老師向學生打哂電報，提示佢哋要温邊題。
target: No one passed the last exam, so this time the teacher provided hints to help students prepare for revision.

en: Joining this tour group has put myself in distress.
zh: 跟呢個旅行團簡直係受難。
target: Joining this tour group has been an unpleasant experience for me.

en: Joining this tour group has put myself in distress.
zh: 跟呢個旅行團簡直係受難。
target: Joining this tour group has been a distressing experience for me.

en: They are "biting ears" over there. Not sure whose bad words they are saying. (=They must be saying bad words about someone.)
zh: 佢哋兩個喺度咬耳仔，唔知喺度講緊邊個壞話呢。
target: They are whispering over there and must be talking about someone behind their back.

en: Public opinions in Philadelphia towards this president have been wavering.
zh: 呢個總統喺#賓州 嘅民意搖擺不定。
target: Public opinion in Philadelphia towards this president has been wavering.

en: Public opinions in Philadelphia towards this president have been wavering.
zh: 呢個總統喺#賓州 嘅民意搖擺不定。
target: Public opinion in Philadelphia towards this president has been unstable.

en: To discipline your child, you need to give them both the hits and the sweets.
zh: 教細路仔有時要軟硬兼施，佢哋先會服你㗎。
target: Teaching children requires a balance of discipline and kindness; they will respond to you better that way.

en: I have a lot of these left, you can eat with no scruple.
zh: 仲有大把呀，唔使就住食啦。
target: There are plenty more, feel free to eat them.

en: By spending so much on the EMBA course, I want only to angle for reputation, and never meant to study hard.
zh: 我使咁多錢讀EMBA，只不過想沽名釣譽啫，真係咁有心機讀書咩。
target: I spent so much on the EMBA course just for reputation, not because I had a genuine interest in studying.

en: Shit! I forgot the fish on the pan, and it got burnt.
zh: 弊！無睇火，煎緊條魚燶晒！
target: Oh no! I forgot about the fish on the pan, and it got burnt.

en: How can you kill your own children? You animal.
zh: 連親生骨肉你都殺，你仲係咪人嚟㗎！
target: How can you kill your own children? You're an animal.

en: I am not a expert of stock trading.
zh: 炒股票我唔在行。
target: I'm not good at stock trading.

en: One must use anchor bolt but not typical screw to install hanging cabinet.
zh: 吊櫃一定要用爆炸螺絲，唔可以就咁用普通螺絲。
target: One must use anchor bolts instead of typical screws for hanging cabinet installations.

en: I forgot to get off. I don't know how to go back now.
zh: 我唔記得咗落車，而家都唔知點樣返返去。
target: I forgot to get off the bus, now I don't know how to get to my destination.

en: I forgot to get off. I don't know how to go back now.
zh: 我唔記得咗落車，而家都唔知點樣返返去。
target: I forgot to get off the bus, now I don't know how to return.

en: That guy in the lift looks a bit evil, I better wait for the next lift.
zh: 𨋢入面個人賊眉賊眼噉，我都係等第二架𨋢嚹。
target: The man in the lift appears suspicious, so I'll take the next one.

en: Are you telling me how to do, newbie? I'm way more experienced!
zh: 校服都未除教我做嘢？我食鹽多過你食米呀！
target: Don't tell me what to do, inexperienced person; I've got more experience than you!

en: A-chung is playing cricket fighting.
zh: 阿松玩緊鬥蟋蟀。
target: A-chung is engaged in a cricket fighting game.

en: Nowadays, with eating meat or drinking hot tea being labeled as carcinogenic, do we have choices other than fasting as a means of achieving immortality?
zh: 而家食紅肉又話致癌，飲熱茶又話致癌，咁乜都唔食煉仙好過啦？
target: Eating red meat and drinking hot tea has been claimed to cause cancer, what can we do besides fasting for longevity?

en: Nowadays, with eating meat or drinking hot tea being labeled as carcinogenic, do we have choices other than fasting as a means of achieving immortality?
zh: 而家食紅肉又話致癌，飲熱茶又話致癌，咁乜都唔食煉仙好過啦？
target: With eating red meat and drinking hot tea linked to cancer, what other options do we have besides fasting for longevity?

en: He was cursed with Gong Tau during his trip.
zh: 佢去旅行嗰陣畀人落咗降頭。
target: He was put under a curse during his trip.

en: Wow! You are so well-endowed!
zh: 嘩！你好大兜呀！
target: Wow! You are very well-built!

en: You brat! How dare you steal my stuff!
zh: 死𡃁仔，夠膽撻我嘢！
target: You brat! How dare you touch my things!

en: Hi-tech business goes south, low-tech business goes north.
zh: C. Hi-tech揩嘢，low-tech撈嘢。
target: The high-tech businesses are struggling, while the low-tech businesses are thriving.

en: Hi-tech business goes south, low-tech business goes north.
zh: C. Hi-tech揩嘢，low-tech撈嘢。
target: The high-tech business is struggling, while the low-tech one is thriving.

en: He broke a child's leg because the child accidentally stepped on his foot! How cruel he is!
zh: 個細路唔小心踩到阿強，阿強就打斷佢隻腳，好毒辣囉。
target: He broke a child's leg after the child accidentally stepped on his foot! Such a cruel person!

en: He broke a child's leg because the child accidentally stepped on his foot! How cruel he is!
zh: 個細路唔小心踩到阿強，阿強就打斷佢隻腳，好毒辣囉。
target: He broke a child's leg after the child accidentally stepped on his foot! How cruel he was!

en: I could go there and see that superstar and so what? We are only allowed to look at him but not owning him or touching him.
zh: 我去到望到個明星咁又點喎，都係得個睇字架啫。
target: What's the point of seeing that superstar up close if we can't interact with him? We're only allowed to look but not touch or own him.

en: Damn it, it's gone too far!
zh: 弊家伙，今鋪過咗火！
target: Oh no, we've gone too far this time!

en: Damn it, it's gone too far!
zh: 弊家伙，今鋪過咗火！
target: Damn it, this has gone too far!

en: If you don't pay the ransom, I will kill the hostage.
zh: 你唔俾贖款我就撕票。
target: Pay the ransom or the hostage dies.

en: I lost all my money when I was playing mahjong with my family.
zh: 琴日同屋企人打麻雀，我輸到輸剩條底褲。
target: Yesterday, playing mahjong with my family, I lost all my money down to my underwear.

en: He hasn't paid attention to the traffic just now, and almost went to check in at Yama king's court.
zh: 佢頭先過馬路唔睇車，爭啲要去閻羅王處報到。
target: He didn't pay attention to the traffic just now and nearly got sent directly to the underworld.

en: He hasn't paid attention to the traffic just now, and almost went to check in at Yama king's court.
zh: 佢頭先過馬路唔睇車，爭啲要去閻羅王處報到。
target: He didn't pay attention to the traffic just now and nearly got into an accident.

en: His parents always wanted him to marry a good wife, have a grand banquet, despite the fact that he is gay but he could still maintain a good reputation for the clan.
zh: 父母一直都希望佢娶個好老婆，搞一場豪門夜宴，就算係#基 嘅都叫做為佢地家族做咗場好戲。
target: His parents always wanted him to marry a good wife and host a grand banquet, even though he is gay, as it would uphold their family's reputation.

en: I lost my textbook just before the examination, how unfortunate I am.
zh: 臨考試之前先唔見咗本書，真係好黑仔。
target: I lost my textbook just before the exam, what bad luck!

en: Please ask him to call me when he wakes up.
zh: 佢瞓醒唔該你叫佢打電話俾我啦。
target: Ask him to call me when he wakes up.

en: The old wisedom said "To leave everything a room for manoeuvre, you will be easier when you meet others some days later", as he had apologized and compensated for the lost, I think we should forgive him for this issue.
zh: 正所謂「凡事留一線，他日好相見」，既然佢肯道歉同賠償，不如件事就咁算啦。
target: As they say - "burn no bridges; you may need to cross them again." Given that he is willing to apologize and compensate your losses, let's just settle the issue.

en: The old wisedom said "To leave everything a room for manoeuvre, you will be easier when you meet others some days later", as he had apologized and compensated for the lost, I think we should forgive him for this issue.
zh: 正所謂「凡事留一線，他日好相見」，既然佢肯道歉同賠償，不如件事就咁算啦。
target: As he apologized and compensated, it's best to forgive him for this issue.

en: You borrowed my money and you ran away, how can you face me?
zh: 你借完我錢就走佬，你對得住我㗎嗱？
target: After borrowing my money, you ran away; how could you do this to me?

en: You borrowed my money and you ran away, how can you face me?
zh: 你借完我錢就走佬，你對得住我㗎嗱？
target: After borrowing my money, you ran away; how could you face me?

en: He helped that billionaire to do religious rituals, earning several hundreds of millions already, but was still unsatisfied; he was way too greedy that he tried to defraud the whole inheritance of the billionaire.
zh: 佢幫富商做法事賺左幾億都唔夠，仲想呃埋人地成份遺產，真係人心不足蛇吞象。
target: He earned several hundred million dollars by performing religious rituals for a billionaire but was still not satisfied; his greed led him to try and defraud the entire inheritance.

en: He helped that billionaire to do religious rituals, earning several hundreds of millions already, but was still unsatisfied; he was way too greedy that he tried to defraud the whole inheritance of the billionaire.
zh: 佢幫富商做法事賺左幾億都唔夠，仲想呃埋人地成份遺產，真係人心不足蛇吞象。
target: He earned several hundred million dollars by doing religious rituals for a billionaire but was still not satisfied; his greed led him to try and defraud the entire inheritance.

en: I have eaten Pekingese cusine.
zh: 我食過北京菜。
target: I have tried Beijing cuisine before.

en: I have eaten Pekingese cusine.
zh: 我食過北京菜。
target: I have tried Beijing cuisine.

en: He throws to us every time when he meets something that he doesn't know how to solve, I will ignore him from now on. If you want to help him you work on your own, I will not waste my time and energy.
zh: 每次佢唔識做嗰啲嘢都掟比我哋做，由而家開始我唔會再理佢㗎喇，你要幫佢做就自己幫啦，我冇你咁好氣！
target: Whenever he encounters something he can't handle, he just passes it over to us. From now on, I will ignore him. If you want to help him, do it yourself; I won't waste my time on this.

en: God would punish those who often intimidate others in God's name.
zh: 成日濫用上天嘅名號去咒人畀「皇天擊殺」係會遭天譴㗎！
target: Threatening others in God's name will bring divine retribution!

en: gym (heoi3 zhim1) to go to a gym
zh: 去
target: To go to a gym

en: Why are you standing so close to me? Are you trying to grope me?
zh: 你企咁埋做咩啊，想搏懵呀？
target: Why are you standing so close to me? Are you trying to touch me?

en: She is married and has two kids.
zh: 佢唔只已婚，仲有兩個小朋友。
target: Not only is she married, but she also has two children.

en: She is married and has two kids.
zh: 佢唔只已婚，仲有兩個小朋友。
target: She's married and has two children.

en: You can win 1st prize in Mark Six, in your dream!
zh: 想中六合彩？發夢啦。
target: You want to win the first prize in Mark Six? Not in your dreams!

en: You can win 1st prize in Mark Six, in your dream!
zh: 想中六合彩？發夢啦。
target: Winning the first prize in Mark Six is just a pipe dream!

en: I can't deal with him but only keep him waiting.
zh: 我都搞佢唔掂，而家係噉出拖字訣先㗎咋。
target: I can't handle him, so I'm just stalling for now.

en: Last year I did not cut my hair yet. At that time I dyed my hair.
zh: 我上年啲頭髮未剪短，嗰時有染髮。
target: Last year, I hadn't cut my hair yet; at that time, I dyed it.

en: Don't take the money. He's trying to trap you!
zh: 唔好攞啲錢呀，佢陰你咋！
target: Don't take the money! He's trying to cheat you!

en: How many parking tickets did you receive last year? It's no big deal.
zh: 你上年罰咗幾張#牛肉乾 話？哎，講呢啲。
target: How many parking tickets did you get last year? Bah, don't mention it.

en: How many parking tickets did you receive last year? It's no big deal.
zh: 你上年罰咗幾張#牛肉乾 話？哎，講呢啲。
target: How many parking tickets did you get last year? Forget about it.

en: Feeling good, isn't it?
zh: 你都咪話唔爽。
target: Feels good, doesn't it?

en: Feeling good, isn't it?
zh: 你都咪話唔爽。
target: Aren't you feeling good?

en: That girl deliberately ignored my messages, should I keep on finding her ?
zh: 個女仔藍剔我，仲揾唔揾佢好？
target: That girl ghosted me, should I still try to reach out to her?

en: There are still hostile forces among the country after revolution.
zh: 呢個國家啱啱搞完革命，國內仲有好多敵對勢力未肅清。
target: The country has just gone through a revolution, and many opposition forces still remain.

en: He was so scared that he was frozen into the pose of standing stick and didn't say anything.
zh: 佢可能受驚過度，所以戙咗喺度唔出聲。
target: He was so scared that he froze in place and didn't say anything.

en: I pay for your food and rent; if you insist on not paying me back, get lost!
zh: 你食我嘅，住我嘅；你再唔畀翻個錢我，你就扯罷啦你！
target: I pay for your food and rent; if you refuse to pay me back, get lost!

en: It's freaking meaningless for you to say that.
zh: 你講嚟都多嚿魚。
target: Your words are utterly meaningless.

en: Even if we go to prison, we don't need to be afraid, as we all have a chance to resume our previous high morals.
zh: 就算坐監都唔使驚，十八年後又一條好漢囉！
target: Even if we go to prison, there's no need to fear; we'll still have a chance to be heroes again after 18 years.

en: No girl would date a geek like you.
zh: 冇女仔會鍾意你啲咁毒嘅人囉。
target: No girl would date someone as obsessed with video games as you.

en: How do you feel? (Are you well?) Do you need to see the doctor?
zh: 你見點啊？使唔使睇醫生？
target: How are you feeling? Do you need to see a doctor?

en: How do you feel? (Are you well?) Do you need to see the doctor?
zh: 你見點啊？使唔使睇醫生？
target: How are you feeling? Do you think you should see a doctor?

en: Are you really okay?! (intended reading: What's wrong with you?!)
zh: 你冇嘢嘛？
target: What's wrong with you?!

en: Be careful when you in the unfamiliar place.
zh: 喺陌生嘅地方要小心啲。
target: Be vigilant when you are in an unfamiliar place.

en: Be careful when you in the unfamiliar place.

zh: 話一就一，話二就二

zh: 乜你笑點咁低㗎！低到冇下限噉！

zh: 佢咁話我，其實係想指桑罵槐，鬧你！

zh: 果邊咁濕，行開嚟啦。
target: It's so wet over there, let's move away.

zh: 阿媽話細路仔衫唔好打霧水，啲衫沾咗濕氣細路仔再著就好易病，應該朝早晾衫，入夜前就收。
target: My mom said children's clothes shouldn't be left outside overnight as the dampness could cause sickness when they wear them. They should be hung up in the morning and collected before evening.

zh: 人哋千金小姐嚟㗎，點會肯做呢啲粗重嘢呀？

zh: 佢感冒唔可以食凍嘢，你唔好食雪糕引佢喇。
target: He has a cold and shouldn't eat anything cold, so don't eat ice cream in front of him.

zh: 躝開啦你！唔好阻住我！

target: I spent the whole night staring at the ceiling, unable to sleep.

zh: 做幾份長散，收入加埋同一份正職差唔多。
target: Having several part-time jobs in the long-term can yield a similar income to a full-time job.

zh: 你腹大便便就唔好四圍去啦。
target: With your big belly, it's better not to wander around too much.

target: Leung resorted to underhanded tactics to become student union chairperson, using the student newspaper to criticize Tang's misbehavior during lessons - playing with his phone in class. However, he was guilty of the same conduct.

target: Yellowish pig liver, also known as 'hong sa', comes from the livers of suckling pigs weighing between 7.5 and 10 kilograms.

target: A breakwater is a structure built out into the sea to protect against waves.

target: It's better to call in sick than arrive late.

target: You should leave after washing the car thoroughly.

target: The election is intensely competitive, with even traditional safe seats seeing intense battles.

zh: 條喉要裝喺邊？個開埋數係幾多？

target: You didn't check your backup camera and squeezed your car into a blind spot. You could have killed me!

en: Last week, Chan Tai Man got into a car accident at Tolo Harbour and bled from every orifice. Luckily, he's alright now.
zh: 陳大文上星期喺吐露港炒車，七孔流血，好在最後冇事咋。
target: Last week, Chan Tai Man was severely injured in a car accident at Tolo Harbour; luckily, he's alright now.

en: Many people here are unpopular guys.
zh: 呢度好多人都係毒男。
target: Many people here are socially awkward men.

en: Many people here are unpopular guys.
zh: 呢度好多人都係毒男。
target: Many people here are socially awkward guys.

en: The transformer works poorly that the computer does not run smoothly enough.
zh: 火牛唔多夠力，部電腦行得唔夠順。
target: The power supply has insufficient power, causing the computer to run poorly.

en: The transformer works poorly that the computer does not run smoothly enough.
zh: 火牛唔多夠力，部電腦行得唔夠順。
target: The power supply is insufficient, causing the computer to run poorly.

en: This pile of paper is for my rough work.
zh: 呢沓紙我愛嚟做算草㗎。
target: I use these papers for rough calculations.

en: My maid would occasionally transfer money back home to support building houses.
zh: 我工人姐姐間唔中就會匯錢返屋企起屋。
target: From time to time, my maid sends money back home to support her family in constructing houses.

en: My maid would occasionally transfer money back home to support building houses.
zh: 我工人姐姐間唔中就會匯錢返屋企起屋。
target: My maid sometimes sends money back home to support building houses.

en: The principal played nepotism, promoting Mr. Wong to department head.
zh: 黃Sir同校長好熟，靠裙帶關係先升到做主任。
target: Mr. Wong was friends with the principal, so he got promoted to head of department due to nepotism.

en: The principal played nepotism, promoting Mr. Wong to department head.
zh: 黃Sir同校長好熟，靠裙帶關係先升到做主任。
target: Mr. Wong got promoted to department head due to his connections.

en: Get lost, don't stand in my way!
zh: 行開啲啦，喺度阻頭阻勢！
target: Please move aside; you're in my way.

en: Actors should also sleeve up and fold their water sleeves well.
zh: 演員啲水袖仲要收得靚、摺得靚㗎噃。
target: Actors must execute their water sleeve movements elegantly.

en: Yesterday he suddenly collapsed in the street due to chest pain.
zh: 佢尋日行行吓街忽然心口痛到#𨀤低 咗。
target: Yesterday, he suddenly collapsed in the street due to severe chest pain.

en: If you are obedient, your parents will love you with no doubt.
zh: 你聽話，爸爸媽媽自然就會錫你。
target: If you're a good boy/girl, mummy and daddy will certainly love you.

en: If you are obedient, your parents will love you with no doubt.
zh: 你聽話，爸爸媽媽自然就會錫你。
target: If you're obedient, your parents will certainly love you.

en: I keep working and now have a mental fatigue.
zh: 我做嘢做到個人跳晒掣。
target: After working so much, I'm mentally exhausted.

en: The boss assigned him to be the representative.
zh: J. #老闆 打發咗佢去做#代表。
target: The boss assigned him to represent the company in a rather offhand manner.

en: The new boss prefers actuality over fluffs. So that brownnoser hits a wall today.
zh: 新老細份人鍾意做實事，搞到嗰隻馬屁精今日奶晒鞋底。
target: The new boss prefers substance over superficiality; therefore, the sycophant is having a rough day.

en: He was so tired that he didn't bother anything and went to bed straight after he reached home.
zh: 佢攰到唔理三七廿一，返到屋企就即刻瞓覺。
target: He was so tired that he didn't care about anything and went straight to bed as soon as he got home.

en: The vegetable is fresh.
zh: 啲菜好#新鮮。
target: The vegetables are very fresh.

en: The vegetable is fresh.
zh: 啲菜好#新鮮。
target: The vegetable is very fresh.

en: I have an angry ugly housewife.
zh: 我屋企個黃面婆好惡。
target: I have an ill-tempered wife.

en: Parents should keep a lenient attitude towards their children as possible and avoid treating them with negative manners of communication.
zh: 家長應該盡量對小朋友保持寬容嘅態度，避免以負面嘅溝通方式對待。
target: Parents should maintain a patient approach towards their children and avoid communicating in negative terms.

en: Parents should keep a lenient attitude towards their children as possible and avoid treating them with negative manners of communication.
zh: 家長應該盡量對小朋友保持寬容嘅態度，避免以負面嘅溝通方式對待。
target: Parents should maintain a patient approach towards their children and avoid negative communication.

en: You have to fulfill company's budgeted revenue before every year-end, or you will be to be reprimanded by a superior.
zh: 做呢行一到年尾就要追數交quota，唔夠數會俾老細照肺㗎！
target: You must meet the company's revenue targets by year-end, or risk getting reprimanded by management.

en: You have to fulfill company's budgeted revenue before every year-end, or you will be to be reprimanded by a superior.
zh: 做呢行一到年尾就要追數交quota，唔夠數會俾老細照肺㗎！
target: You must meet the company's revenue targets by year-end, or risk facing consequences from upper management.

en: She was so happy that she turned three rolls on the lawn.
zh: 佢開心到喺草地度打咗三個關斗。
target: She was so happy that she did three cartwheels on the lawn.

en: You don't even consider how difficult it was for your mother to give birth to you!
zh: 你都唔諗吓老母扽你出嚟幾辛苦！
target: Don't you realize how difficult it was for your mother to bringing you into this world?

en: You don't even consider how difficult it was for your mother to give birth to you!
zh: 你都唔諗吓老母扽你出嚟幾辛苦！
target: Don't you realize how much effort your mother put into bringing you into this world?

en: In Mainland, people don't call him "bik1 haam4", but use the name bui3-haak1-something-something instead.
zh: 大陸唔係叫佢做碧咸㗎，叫貝克咩咩咁㗎！
target: In Mainland China, people don't call him 'Beckham'; instead, they use a name like Beike-something-something.

en: In Mainland, people don't call him "bik1 haam4", but use the name bui3-haak1-something-something instead.
zh: 大陸唔係叫佢做碧咸㗎，叫貝克咩咩咁㗎！
target: In Mainland China, people don't call him 'Beckham'; instead, they use a name like Baike Qian or something similar.

en: A-chung got lost in watching Moe girl anime and hadn't slept for days. Result? He had a seizure last night and got sent to the hospital.
zh: 阿松沉溺睇#萌娘 動畫幾日唔#瞓覺，結果尋晚睇睇吓#發羊吊 入咗#醫院。
target: A-chung became obsessed with watching Moe girl anime and didn't sleep for days. As a result, he had a seizure last night and was rushed to the hospital.

en: Add (food) to a wok and stir-fry for two minutes.
zh: 落鑊炒兩分鐘。
target: Stir-fry in a wok for two minutes after adding the food.

en: Let's bet on how late he will be.
zh: 我哋開盤賭下佢會遲幾耐先到？
target: Let's make a wager on how late he'll arrive.

en: Listen to this. If you're smart enough, you'd better keep your mouth shut. You know what I mean?
zh: 我警告你啊，你精精哋就唔好四圍同人講啊，知唔知啊吓？
target: Take my advice. If you're smart, keep your mouth shut. You understand?

en: Don't waste food, or you'll get bad karma.
zh: 唔好咁折墮嘥嘢食。
target: Don't waste food; it brings bad karma.

en: You room is such a mess. Go and tidy your stuff.
zh: 你間房太亂喇，快啲執下你啲嘢喇。
target: Your room is such a mess. Please clean up your things.

en: iPhone to buy a second-hand iPhone at a high price
zh: 高價收購二手
target: buying second-hand iPhone at a high price

en: iPhone to buy a second-hand iPhone at a high price
zh: 高價收購二手
target: I am willing to pay a high price for a second-hand iPhone.

en: You still have time to stop right now.
zh: 你而家收手仲嚟得切。
target: It's not too late to stop.

en: There are lots of cream on the cake, so heavy.
zh: 蛋糕上面有好多忌廉，好肥㗎。
target: The cake has a lot of cream, making it very rich.

en: To use different white balance settings when the light source differs.
zh: 喺唔同嘅光源底下要用唔同嘅白平衡設定。
target: Adjust the white balance setting depending on the light source.

en: If I still don't go back home, my wife will scold me!
zh: 再唔交人老婆鬧喇！
target: If I'm not home soon, my wife will give me a hard time!

en: Do you know your own place? How dare you talk to the boss with such tone?
zh: 你知唔知埞呀？咁同我大佬講嘢？
target: Do you know your place? How dare you speak to the boss in such a tone?

en: Sam So is a famous author in Hong Kong writing in saam kap dai.
zh: 三蘇係香港著名嘅三及第作家。
target: Sam So is a renowned author of samp gok daap (Cantonese literature) in Hong Kong.

en: Boss, what dishes would you like?
zh: 老細，要啲咩餸噉呢？
target: Hey boss, what dishes would you like today?

en: Are you insane? Hitting me right in the head is so painful!
zh: 你傻嘎？兜頭拍落嚟！痛㗎。
target: Are you crazy? Hitting someone in the head hurts!

en: I mean, all of you are rubbish.
zh: 我係話在座各位都係垃圾。
target: In fact, all of you are rubbish.

en: Miss Cheung is self-opinionated, obstinate and bumptious; she never takes others' advice.
zh: 張小姐係個剛愎自用嘅人，從來都唔會聽人意見。
target: Miss Cheung is stubborn and never takes others' advice.

en: Your face becomes so dirty with your make up.
zh: 化妝化到成個大花面咁，好樣衰呀！
target: Your makeup makes your face look very messy.

en: How to pass those days?
zh: 點樣度過呢啲日子？
target: How do I get through these days?

en: "Small dishes" include Chinese pastry and buns.
zh: 小點有糕點同包。
target: Dim Sum includes Chinese pastries and buns.

en: This is surely not the way to do it.
zh: 咁做法死梗㗎。
target: Surely, this isn't the way to do it.

en: What are you following me for?
zh: 你跟住我有咩企圖啊？
target: Why are you following me?

en: Our department will refer this case for you to follow.
zh: 呢單case我哋部門會refer畀你哋跟。
target: Our department will forward this case to your team for follow-up.

en: We have to probe the adversaries' background details in order to win every time.
zh: 我哋摸清楚人哋嘅底細，先可以百戰百勝。
target: We must thoroughly understand our adversaries' backgrounds to ensure we always win.

en: You're so weird! You just said that you don't like that thing. But after you left, you want to buy it!
zh: 乜你咁搞笑架！明明話唔鍾意，走咗之後又要買！
target: You're so inconsistent! You just told me you didn't like it, but after you left, you want to buy it!

en: The waitress had on quite a bitch face.
zh: 個侍應面口好閪。
target: The waitress looked very unfriendly.

en: Don't be so timid, it is unnecessary to go to the ER for a small headache.
zh: 你唔好咁蛇𠺌啦，少少頭痛唔使睇急症呀？
target: Don't overreact - a minor headache doesn't require an emergency room visit.

en: What a good *opportunity* you offered me!
zh: 乜咁好帶挈呀？
target: What a good favor you did for me!

en: In the old days, people would go to Yuen Long and buy several piculs of wife cake.
zh: 以前啲人結婚前會入元朗買幾擔老婆餅。
target: In the old days, people would go to Yuen Long and buy several piculs of wife cakes before their weddings.

en: to compliment someone is better than their teacher; lit:indigo blue is extracted from the indigo plant but is bluer than the plant it comes from
zh: H. #青出於藍而勝於藍
target: The student surpasses the teacher, or for a full expression: One can be bluer than the indigo plant from which they came.

en: You take the clothes to the laundry room to wash it.
zh: 你拎啲衫去洗衣房度洗啦。
target: Take the clothes to the laundry room to wash them.

en: We'll now have a drill on the competition run down first.
zh: 我哋而家會dem一次比賽個流程先。
target: Let's go through a practice run of the competition procedure first.

en: We'll now have a drill on the competition run down first.
zh: 我哋而家會dem一次比賽個流程先。
target: Let's practice the competition's process first.

en: Jockey Club opens every day, they always welcome you to bet. (Literally: they always not afraid that you won't go to bet)
zh: 馬會日日都開門，唔慌你唔嚟賭。
target: The Jockey Club is open every day, so you're always welcome to place a bet. (Literally: they always not afraid that you won't go to bet)

en: Jockey Club opens every day, they always welcome you to bet. (Literally: they always not afraid that you won't go to bet)
zh: 馬會日日都開門，唔慌你唔嚟賭。
target: The Jockey Club is open every day, so you're always welcome to place a bet.

en: How do you feel? Do you need to see the doctor?
zh: 你見點啊？使唔使睇醫生？
target: How are you feeling? Do you need to see a doctor?

en: Your way of doing things is outdated. Go away!
zh: 你嗰套脱晒節㗎喇，收檔罷啦！
target: Your way of doing things is way out of date, it's time you took a break.

en: Your way of doing things is outdated. Go away!
zh: 你嗰套脱晒節㗎喇，收檔罷啦！
target: Your methods are outdated, it's time to change.

en: I have been winning every gambling I was in. I guess I am quite lucky these days.
zh: 我呢排都幾幸運，賭親乜都贏。
target: I've been on a winning streak with all my bets lately; seems like luck is on my side.

en: You will be a star? Don't dream!
zh: 你會做到明星？唔好發夢啦！
target: You want to become a pop star? Only in your dreams!

en: You will be a star? Don't dream!
zh: 你會做到明星？唔好發夢啦！
target: Will you be a star? Don't count on it!

en: "You are smart!"  "It isn't so!"
zh: 「你好叻喎！」「邊度係呢？」
target: "You are smart!" "That's not true!"

en: How does he look like?
zh: 佢個樣點㗎？
target: What does he look like?

en: Are there any girls?
zh: 有冇女先？
target: Are there any girls there?

en: Are there any girls?
zh: 有冇女先？
target: Are there any girls here?

en: School is a place to for people to imbibe knowledge, not for you to mess around.
zh: 學校係吸收新知識嘅地方，唔係畀你搞搞震。
target: School is a place for learning new things, not for fooling around.

en: Your friend is working in the A brand sport shoes distributor, can you help me to make a connection on procurement of a batch of limited edition sport shoes?
zh: 你朋友響A記波鞋代理度做，可唔可以幫我搭路訂批限量版波鞋？
target: Your friend works at the A brand sport shoes distributor. Could you use your connections to help me order some limited edition sneakers?

en: Your friend is working in the A brand sport shoes distributor, can you help me to make a connection on procurement of a batch of limited edition sport shoes?
zh: 你朋友響A記波鞋代理度做，可唔可以幫我搭路訂批限量版波鞋？
target: Your friend works at the A brand sport shoes distributor. Could you help me get in touch with them to order some limited edition sneakers?

en: Although Chief Executive was ultimately authorized by all citizens in theory, it only voted by less than 1200 people. That is why a Chief Executive never recognized by citizens.
zh: 特首美其名由全港市民授權，但實際上只由唔夠千二人選出嚟，所以永遠都係著起龍袍唔似太子。
target: Although the Chief Executive is theoretically elected by all citizens, they are chosen by fewer than 1200 people, which is why they are often not widely supported by the public.

en: Why did you hang up a moment ago? The phone had no signal?
zh: 求先做乜扱線啊？電話收唔到？
target: Why did you hang up? Was there no signal?

en: These are common ways to crime.
zh: 呢啲都係犯人常用嘅手法。
target: These are common methods used by criminals.

en: The team has a weak lineup today, I think they will have a certain lose.
zh: 今次隊波陣容咁弱，即係秀才手巾，包輸啦。
target: The team has a weak lineup today; I think they are sure to lose.

en: He's like an idiot. He couldn't understand why I am saying no matter how many times I explained to him.
zh: 佢成嚿大番薯咁，解釋極都唔明。
target: He's just a big potato; he still doesn't understand even after I explained multiple times.

en: He's like an idiot. He couldn't understand why I am saying no matter how many times I explained to him.
zh: 佢成嚿大番薯咁，解釋極都唔明。
target: He's hard to convince; he still doesn't understand even after I explained multiple times.

en: Egg lards must be served together with snake soup. It is tasty!
zh: 食蛇羹一定要落蛋散先正㗎！
target: Snake soup tastes better with egg lards; it's delicious!

en: This dude keeps letting our enemy off, very likely a traitor.
zh: 條友三番四次鬆章畀對家，鬼到爆。
target: He keeps letting our enemy off, likely a traitor.

en: Stupid boss is going to hold useless meeting again.
zh: 腦細又開埋啲無謂會。
target: The boss calls another pointless meeting again.

en: Stupid boss is going to hold useless meeting again.
zh: 腦細又開埋啲無謂會。
target: There's another pointless meeting with the boss again.

en: I want you guys to beat him to a pulp.
zh: 你哋同我抦到佢變豬頭炳。
target: I want you guys to teach him a lesson.

en: Don't be afraid, we all bros will stand by you.
zh: 唔使驚喎，我地成班兄弟實會傍住你。
target: Don't be afraid, we'll all have your back.

en: You rascal, when are you gonna be back home?
zh: 死嘢幾時返屋企？
target: When will you be coming home, scamp?

en: Don't bluff my way out!
zh: 唔好拋我喎！
target: Don't try to bluff me!

en: Don't bluff my way out!
zh: 唔好拋我喎！
target: Don't try to deceive me!

en: Let's go to Five Stations Hill to see celebrities!
zh: 我哋去#五台山 追星囉！
target: Let's go to Mount Wutai to see celebrities!

en: I think I may come to the dinner.
zh: 我諗我會嚟食飯啩。
target: I might come to dinner.

en: There are too many people here, let's talk outside.
zh: 呢度咁多人我哋去開便傾。
target: There are too many people here, let's step out to talk.

en: He is such a girl. He does facial treatments at home all the time, and he buys a lot of skin care products.
zh: 佢好基㗎，成日喺屋企做facial，又買好多護膚品。
target: He's so meticulous about his appearance, always doing facial treatments and buying skin care products.

en: I have been using it for half year, and feel satisfactory for the overall performance.
zh: 用左半年，overall好滿意。
target: I have been using it for six months and I am generally satisfied with it.

en: I have been using it for half year, and feel satisfactory for the overall performance.
zh: 用左半年，overall好滿意。
target: I have been using it for six months and am satisfied with its overall performance.

en: How are you going to send this thing as a letter? Send it as a parcel!
zh: 你呢舊野點寄信呀？寄包裹啦！
target: Can't you send this as a parcel instead of a letter?

en: I was tripped over by the electricity cable.
zh: 我畀條電線棘親。
target: I tripped over the electricity cable.

en: There are 40 standing room for passengers in this bus.
zh: 部車有40個企位。
target: This bus has space for 40 standing passengers.

en: Don't run. You have to mind your feet. You've just recovered.
zh: 唔好跑，因住隻腳先得㗎，你啱啱先好番咋。
target: Be careful not to run. Remember to take care of your feet; you've just recovered.

en: On about 27th February (I will) again notify you.
zh: 二月廿七左右再通知你。
target: I will notify you again around February 27th.

en: Move your lazy ass now! We are late.
zh: 你呢個懶骨頭，快啲行啦遲到啦。
target: Hurry up, lazybones! We're running late.

en: Such a lump of rice (=such an idiot)! You have no idea of what's going on.
zh: 一嚿飯噉，懵盛盛！
target: You are such an idiot! You have no idea what's going on.

en: This amateur was infamous until he posted a video on YouTube.
zh: 呢個素人拍片放上 YouTube 之後一夜成名。
target: This amateur became famous overnight after posting a video on YouTube.

en: (lit.) When are you going to invite me to your wedding feast?
zh: 你幾時請我飲你哋餐喜酒啊？
target: When are you inviting me to your wedding?

en: I poked my head to see who is talking in the corridor.
zh: 我探頭望下邊個喺條走廊度傾偈。
target: I poked my head to see who was talking in the corridor.

en: I poked my head to see who is talking in the corridor.
zh: 我探頭望下邊個喺條走廊度傾偈。
target: I peeked to see who was chatting in the corridor.

en: It's not my fault to lose, it's the lag. Blame my computer.
zh: 唔係 lag 機我一定唔會輸囉，死垃圾電腦。
target: The lag caused me to lose, it's my computer's fault.

en: Shit. Only two hours left. How can I finish the project?
zh: 碌柒喇，得返兩粒鐘，點死份Project出嚟得𠿪？
target: Shit! Only two hours left. How can I finish the project on time?

en: Shit. Only two hours left. How can I finish the project?
zh: 碌柒喇，得返兩粒鐘，點死份Project出嚟得𠿪？
target: "Shoot! Only two hours left. How can I finish the project on time?"

en: He likes to argue so much. One talk nine back.
zh: 佢最鍾意同人拗頸，句句都一言九頂。
target: He enjoys arguing with people and always has a counter-argument for everything.

en: I ordered coffee, but why is it tasteless?
zh: 我嗌嘅係咖啡嚟㗎噃，因乜解究淡過貓尿嘅？
target: I ordered coffee. Why is this thing tasteless?

en: You are using all these gibberish Cantonese "proper" characters in your writing. No one will understand you.
zh: 你用埋晒啲正字寫廣東話，冇人睇得明㗎。
target: You're using "canonical" Cantonese characters in your writing, no one will understand you.

en: You are using all these gibberish Cantonese "proper" characters in your writing. No one will understand you.
zh: 你用埋晒啲正字寫廣東話，冇人睇得明㗎。
target: You're using non-standard Cantonese characters in your writing, no one will understand you.

en: Chiu picked a phone, but by surprise the owner mistaken him as the thief.
zh: 阿釗執到部電話，點知俾機主好人當賊辦。

target: Physicist Nick Wong is well-read in many areas, including feng shui and physiognomy.

en: You're losing, why don't you use your ultimate attack?
zh: 你就嚟輸喇，仲唔出超必？
target: You're losing, why don't you use your ultimate move?

en: I want to give up myself.
zh: 我想放棄自己。
target: I want to give up on myself.

en: He's reserved in front of strangers.
zh: 佢喺生保人面前好扤失。
target: He's quite reserved around strangers.

en: Are you lacking manpower? How can you recruit such useless people?
zh: 你而家好唔夠人咩？呢啲狗屎垃圾你都收？
target: Do you lack enough staff? How did you end up hiring such incompetent people?

en: The Miss HK candidates this years are eye candies.
zh: 今屆啲候選港組真係悦目。
target: The Miss Hong Kong contestants this year are very attractive.

en: The Miss HK candidates this years are eye candies.
zh: 今屆啲候選港組真係悦目。
target: The Miss HK contestants this year are very attractive.

en: She looks totally out of shape. Did she get dumped?
zh: 佢呢排跌晒watt喎，俾人飛呀？
target: She looks out of sorts. Did she experience a breakup?

en: They have had an affair.
zh: 佢哋有過一手。
target: They had an affair.

en: If you stay here for one more second, I will have someone beat you and make you scarper.
zh: 你再唔走呢，我就揾人打到你冇鞋挽屐走。
target: If you don't leave now, I will have someone beat you up.

en: The dragon-lady (of my home) is calling. Bye for now.
zh: 屋企嗰隻老虎乸揾我，係噉先。
target: The tiger lady at home is calling. See you for now.

en: The dragon-lady (of my home) is calling. Bye for now.
zh: 屋企嗰隻老虎乸揾我，係噉先。
target: My domineering partner is calling. Bye for now.

en: The evidence you provided was too vague and too general. It's not convincing enough.
zh: 你嘅論據太空泛，唔夠説服力。
target: Your argument is too general and lacks convincing evidence.

en: Bro! Beat him!
zh: 兄弟！鋤佢！
target: Bro, beat him up!

en: Just one hundred push-ups, easy job.
zh: 一百下掌上壓啫，話咁易啦。
target: It's just one hundred push-ups, easy job.

en: I'd bet anything that I'd win the election without trying.
zh: 賭幾多都得呀，今次選舉我瞓喺度都贏你啦！
target: I'm so confident that I'll win this election without even trying.

en: Her face has been made very dirty by painting.
zh: 佢塊面俾人畫到花面貓噉。
target: Her face is smeared with paint.

en: The girl went to a friend's place and was raped.
zh: 個女仔上朋友屋企俾人姦咗。
target: The girl was sexually assaulted at a friend's place.

en: Today I was unlucky at gambling and lost so much money.
zh: 今日手氣唔好，輸咗好多錢。
target: Today I had bad luck gambling and lost a lot of money.

en: The two of the brothers are always fighting. The older one visited his mother in the retirement home merely once a year, and self righteously, took it upon himself to call his brother an ingrate.
zh: 佢兩兄弟成日狗咬狗骨。個阿哥成年先去老人院探佢阿媽一次，一時唔偷雞就做保長，話個細佬不孝。
target: The two brothers constantly fight. The older one rarely visits their mom in the nursing home, yet arrogantly labels his brother ungrateful whenever he doesn't behave properly.

en: They put all the goods on the sidewalk. Jerks.
zh: 啲人真係好賤格，將啲貨放晒喺行人路度。
target: They placed all the goods on the sidewalk. How inconsiderate.

en: Anyone thinks they are completely worthless?
zh: 有冇人覺得自己唔死都冇用？
target: Does anyone feel completely useless?

en: Oh you want to know that girl? Let me be your intermediary.
zh: 你想識嗰個女仔下嘛？我幫你穿針引線啦。
target: You want to get to know that girl? I'll introduce you two.

en: Today is a big day, maybe I can break my vow somehow and drink two cups?
zh: 今日係大喜日子，破下戒飲兩杯都得啩？
target: Today's a special day, so maybe it doesn't matter if I broke my vow and have a drink or two?

en: Today is a big day, maybe I can break my vow somehow and drink two cups?
zh: 今日係大喜日子，破下戒飲兩杯都得啩？
target: Today's a special day, so maybe I should break my vow and have a drink or two?

en: What kind of powder is it?
zh: 呢啲咩粉末嚟㗎？
target: What kind of powder is this?

en: As the name suggest, an oval face means that one's face has shape of an oval.
zh: 瓜子面顧名思義，就係一個人嘅面型好似瓜子咁樣。
target: An oval face, as the name suggests, has an oval shape.

en: This is called "Tricky Gun", it will fire alternating to the front then to the back.
zh: 呢支叫「古惑的槍」，佢會一次向前射一次向後射梅花間竹噉嚟。
target: This is a 'Tricky Gun'. It fires alternately front and back.

en: This is called "Tricky Gun", it will fire alternating to the front then to the back.
zh: 呢支叫「古惑的槍」，佢會一次向前射一次向後射梅花間竹噉嚟。
target: This is called 'Tricky Gun'. It fires alternately front and back.

en: Remove the fuel is one way of putting out a fire.
zh: 移走燃料係滅火嘅方法之一。
target: One way to put out a fire is to remove the fuel.

en: You need to dedicate your time, even on vacation, to the company.
zh: 你連放假嘅時間都要貢獻俾公司。
target: You even need to dedicate your time off to the company.

en: Stop bullshitting.
zh: 咪喺度噏風啦你。
target: Don't tell me nonsense.

en: He doesn't like iPad? You have no idea how happy he was when he got it on his birthday this year.
zh: 佢咩唔中意iPad呀，佢今年生日收到都唔知幾開心。
target: He doesn't like iPads, you say? You have no idea how happy he was when he got it on his birthday this year.

en: He doesn't like iPad? You have no idea how happy he was when he got it on his birthday this year.
zh: 佢咩唔中意iPad呀，佢今年生日收到都唔知幾開心。
target: He doesn't like iPads? You have no idea how happy he was when he got it on his birthday this year.

en: That factory was revealed to have used gutter oil and its products have been removed from the shelves.
zh: 呢間廠前排俾人踢爆咗用地溝油，啲貨落晒架㗎喇。
target: The factory was found to have used gutter oil, and its products were removed from the shelves.

en: This pair of socks are too thin that you'll get holes on it after wearing it for half a month.
zh: 呢對襪薄切切，着返一頭半個月就穿窿喇。
target: These socks are so thin that they will have holes in them after wearing them for half a month.

en: Try to do something to please her. After a while, she'll naturally forgive you.
zh: 你氹吓佢，佢過一排自自然會原諒你啦。
target: Try to do something nice for her; she'll forgive you eventually.

en: Why you suddenly become so nice today ? You traveled so long just for seeing me?
zh: 做乜咁好死呀？特登咁遠走出嚟探我？
target: Why are you being so kind today? Did you travel all this way just to see me?

en: The pencil is very finely sharpened.
zh: 支鉛筆刨到尖筆甩。
target: The pencil is extremely sharp.

en: Just when A-chung was tasting the dishes A-na cooked and complaining about this and that, I thought he knew very well how to cook. But it turned out that when he cooked, he almost burned the entire kitchen.
zh: 睇阿松正話試阿娜煮嘅餸嗰陣又乜又物咁，仲諗住佢好識煮嘢食。點知佢煮起嘢上嚟差啲燒咗成個廚房。
target: Since A-chung was criticizing the dishes A-na prepared, I thought he knew how to cook. But it turned out that when he cooked, he almost burned down the kitchen.

en: Just when A-chung was tasting the dishes A-na cooked and complaining about this and that, I thought he knew very well how to cook. But it turned out that when he cooked, he almost burned the entire kitchen.
