target: Just as A-chung was tasting the dishes A-na cooked and criticizing this and that, I thought he knew how to cook. But it turned out that when he cooked, he almost burned down the kitchen.

en: So what? How are you better?
zh: 超，你好叻咩？
target: So what? Are you doing better?

en: I push him every day to make him do his homework.
zh: 佢要我日日督住佢先至肯做功課㗎。
target: I have to push him daily to do his homework.

en: It is very unscientific to decide cases by connecting to the spiritual world.
zh: 用通靈嘅方法斷案好唔科學。
target: It is highly unscientific to use spiritual methods to resolve a case.

en: It is very unscientific to decide cases by connecting to the spiritual world.
zh: 用通靈嘅方法斷案好唔科學。
target: It is highly unscientific to use spiritual methods for case resolution.

en: The typhoon has swept down all the trees of this tree.
zh: 個颱風掃平咗成條街嘅樹木。
target: The typhoon has swept down all the trees on this street.

en: I only managed to get this job because he didn't want the offer.
zh: 佢唔要份工，我先執到死雞㗎咋。
target: I only got this job because he turned down the offer.

en: hy have you disappeared these days?
zh: 你呢排做乜潛水呀？ Ｗ
target: Why have you been absent these days?

en: You think property owners will lower the rent these days? You'll be very lucky if it doesn't rise.
zh: 家陣仲諗住業主會減租？唔加都執返身彩嘍。
target: Do you really think that your landlord will reduce the rent? You'd be extremely fortunate if it doesn't increase.

en: You think property owners will lower the rent these days? You'll be very lucky if it doesn't rise.
zh: 家陣仲諗住業主會減租？唔加都執返身彩嘍。
target: Do you really believe that property owners will reduce the rent? You'd be extremely fortunate if it doesn't increase.

en: Why you like to dress in these clothes that with details hanging and swinging around ?
zh: 乜你咁鐘意出街著到成身叮叮髧髧嘅樣？
target: Why do you like to dress in these clothes with so many accessories swirling around?

en: Why you like to dress in these clothes that with details hanging and swinging around ?
zh: 乜你咁鐘意出街著到成身叮叮髧髧嘅樣？
target: Why do you like to wear such detailed clothes that hang and swing around so much?

en: Why do you still wear sport shorts even you are not doing exercise?
zh: 唔係做運動都著PE褲嘅？
target: Why are you still wearing sport shorts when you're not exercising?

en: He doesn't go to study or work, but idles at home.
zh: 佢書又唔讀、工又唔返，日日喺屋企做蛀米大蟲。
target: He neither studies nor works; he just lazes around at home.

en: Dimsum is usually on sale in morning session.
zh: 早市有好多特價點心。
target: Dim sum is often on sale in the morning session.

en: You're not sure whether you'll be there that night? Come on—either present or absent.
zh: 嗰晚你唔知你到唔到？咩唔知啫，一係到一係唔到。
target: What do you mean you're not sure if you'll be there that night? It's either a yes or a no.

en: You're not sure whether you'll be there that night? Come on—either present or absent.
zh: 嗰晚你唔知你到唔到？咩唔知啫，一係到一係唔到。
target: You're not sure if you'll be there that night? It's either a yes or a no.

en: Climb the ladder.
zh: 擒上把梯度。
target: Climb up the ladder.

en: I unintentionally saw his dairy.
zh: 我無意中睇到佢本日記。
target: I unintentionally saw his diary.

en: Wasting things ruins your fortune.
zh: 你咁嘥嘢會折福架！
target: Being wasteful is bad for your karma.

en: Wasting things ruins your fortune.
zh: 你咁嘥嘢會折福架！
target: Wasting things brings bad luck.

en: That guy has tattoos all over his body. He looks like he want to murder someone.
zh: 呢個人成身紋身，殺氣好大。
target: That guy is covered in tattoos and looks very intimidating.

en: He skipped town and left his family with a huge sum of gamble debt, what a doombringer to his family.
zh: 佢潛逃之後要屋企人同佢還一大筆賭債，認真佗衰家。
target: He fled and left his family with a large gambling debt. He was such a disaster.

en: He skipped town and left his family with a huge sum of gamble debt, what a doombringer to his family.
zh: 佢潛逃之後要屋企人同佢還一大筆賭債，認真佗衰家。
target: He fled and left his family with a large gambling debt, bringing disaster upon them.

en: What is the use of knowing how to talk? It's just bullshitting with no use.
zh: 講嘢好叻又有咩用啫，咪又係死剩把口？
target: Knowing how to talk well is useless if it's just empty words.

en: That man can sing really low.
zh: 個阿叔可以唱到好低音。
target: That man has a really low singing voice.

en: It's late at night and you still ain't sleeping - that is not good for your body.
zh: 夜夜又唔去瞓，噉會好傷身㗎。
target: It's very late at night and you still aren't sleeping - that is not good for your body.

en: Wow! He's touching her like that, is he gaining advantage of her or what?
zh: 嘩！佢咁去摸人仲唔係搏大霧？
target: Wow! Is he taking advantage of her?

en: From your poor look, I can tell that you must have lost all your money.
zh: 睇你個衰樣，我就知你一定係輸晒啲錢。
target: From your miserable look, I can tell you've lost all your money.

en: Sleepwalking is a disease, you need to see a doctor.
zh: 夢遊係一種病，要睇醫生架！
target: Sleepwalking requires medical attention.

en: you need a licence to play with firearm in Hong Kong.
zh: 香港燒槍要攞牌。
target: In Hong Kong, a permit is required to handle firearms.

en: He is a bad person, you don't have to treat him kindly
zh: 呢啲人咁衰，你唔使對佢咁仁慈架喎！
target: He's a bad person; you don't have to treat him kindly.

en: Are you able to win him in the fight?
zh: 你打唔打得過佢啊？
target: Can you beat him in a fight?

en: If I don't have you with me, I don't know how can I come over the hardtime.
zh: 多得你我先可以走出人生嘅低谷。
target: Without you, I wouldn't have made it through the hard times.

en: This handbag cost a fortune! Paying for it gave me major heartache.
zh: 個手袋好貴㗎，我俾錢嗰陣個心不知幾赤啊。
target: This handbag is so expensive; paying for it was a major heartache.

en: You didn't come at an inopportune time.
zh: 你嚟得唔合時。
target: You came at the wrong time.

en: You dressed slovenly, it is difficult to have girls love you.
zh: 你着衫不修邊幅，好難有女仔鍾意。
target: You keep wearing shabby clothes, you will have a hard time getting girls to like you.

en: You dressed slovenly, it is difficult to have girls love you.
zh: 你着衫不修邊幅，好難有女仔鍾意。
target: Your slovenly dressing makes it difficult for girls to like you.

en: A: "The bread is not enough for my stomach." B: "Maybe a sandwich can be."
zh: 甲：「嚿麪包都唔醫肚嘅。」乙：「加多塊三文治應該幾醫（到）肚吓。」
target: A: "This bread isn't filling enough." B: "Maybe a sandwich would be more satisfying."

en: to quote lines from a book of ancient times
zh: 引用古書上面啲句子
target: to quote lines from ancient texts

en: to quote lines from a book of ancient times
zh: 引用古書上面啲句子
target: Quoting lines from ancient texts.

en: band closer than friends in the same band
zh: H. #friend過打
target: They are closer as bandmates than friends outside the band.

en: Chaising for the bus made me breath so heavily.
zh: 追車追到我係噉透大氣。
target: Chasing after the bus left me out of breath.

en: You still owe me money, pay up!
zh: 你仲未還錢俾我喎，磅水！
target: You still owe me money, please pay up!

en: Information technology keeps changing over time. We can spread a message over the world very quickly.
zh: 現代社會通訊嘅方法日新月異，好快就可以將消息傳遍全球。
target: Information technology continually evolves, allowing us to quickly spread messages across the globe.

en: I get diarrhea every time I drink milk.
zh: 次次飲完奶我都實屙㗎。
target: Every time I drink milk, I get diarrhea.

en: I go to tea house sometimes.
zh: 我間唔時都會飲吓茶㗎。
target: I occasionally go to yum-cha.

en: I go to tea house sometimes.
zh: 我間唔時都會飲吓茶㗎。
target: I occasionally visit a tea house.

en: Will you lost interest seeing each other everyday?
zh: 日對夜對，會唔會冇曬興趣？
target: Will you lose interest in each other if you see each other every day?

en: Come here! Do me a favour!
zh: 嚟喇，拍硬檔喇！
target: Come here and help me out!

en: Your result is barely pass, you would better apply some "lifebuoy subjects" such as anthropology, religious studies.
zh: 你成績咁抆水，揾啲人類學、神學做水泡科好喎。
target: Your grades are very average. You should consider applying for degrees that are easier to get into, like anthropology or religious studies.

en: Your result is barely pass, you would better apply some "lifebuoy subjects" such as anthropology, religious studies.
zh: 你成績咁抆水，揾啲人類學、神學做水泡科好喎。
target: Your grades are just passing; you should consider taking easier subjects like anthropology or religious studies.

en: You are always giggling and being playful.
zh: 成日KI KI 卡卡，一啲都唔正經。
target: You're always giggling and being unserious.

en: I just like that he is (qualified to be) special.
zh: 我就係鍾意佢夠特別。
target: I specifically like how unique he is.

en: I just like that he is (qualified to be) special.
zh: 我就係鍾意佢夠特別。
target: I just like how unique he is.

en: The Pokeball charger can help you to become the best pokemon trainer.
zh: 精靈球充電器可以幫你成為最top嘅訓練大師。
target: The Pokeball charger will help you become the ultimate Pokemon master.

en: New Territories indigenous work as a norm for all those years, and they only know recently that transferring the "Male Indigenous's Right" is actually illegal.
zh: 新界原居民過咗咁多年，依家先至知原來套丁係犯法。
target: New Territories residents have followed this custom for many years, but only recently learned that transferring 'Male Indigenous's Right' is illegal.
